% portfolio.tex
% Visual companion to resume.tex — this is where photos, galleries, and
% project write-ups live. Content in latex/portfolio/sections/*.tex is
% AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build.py from data/*.yaml — never hand-edit
% those files directly; edit the YAML and rebuild.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage[margin=0.9in]{geometry}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{../shared/theme}              % colors/fonts, generated from data/theme.yaml
\usepackage{../shared/portfolio-macros}   % \projectOpen, \projectPhoto, \projectGallery, ... (also pulls in enumitem)
\input{../shared/title.tex}               % \myName, \myEmail, etc. — generated from data/title.yaml

\graphicspath{{../../}}   % so "media/projects/x/cover.jpg" paths in the YAML resolve as-is

\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, urlcolor=blueprint500, linkcolor=blueprint500}

\titleformat{\section}{\displayfont\bfseries\textSectionHeading\color{graphite900}}{}{0em}{}[{\color{blueprint500}\titlerule[1pt]}]
\titlespacing{\section}{0pt}{18pt}{10pt}

% Standard widow/orphan control — never leave a single line of a
% paragraph stranded alone at the top or bottom of a page. Combined
% with the \needspace calls inside portfolio-macros.sty (which keep
% headings, photos, and galleries attached to their content as whole
% units), this is what keeps page breaks from landing somewhere
% awkward throughout the document.
\clubpenalty=10000
\widowpenalty=10000
\raggedbottom

\begin{document}

% \pdfPageBgColor / \pdfTextColor come from data/theme.yaml's pdf:
% block (see README) — resume.tex and coverletter.tex intentionally
% stay plain white, so this configurability lives only here.
\pagecolor{\pdfPageBgColor}
\color{\pdfTextColor}

% ---- title page — sections/title-page.tex is AUTO-GENERATED from
% data/portfolio-pdf.yaml + data/main.yaml + data/title.yaml. The
% "hero" portion (lede/highlights/image) is fully optional — see
% portfolio-pdf.yaml's title_page.show_hero. Page numbering restarts
% at 1 on the first content page, right after this one. ----
\thispagestyle{empty}
\input{sections/title-page.tex}
\newpage
\setcounter{page}{1}

% ---- projects — sections/projects.tex emits one \section*{...} per
% category (see data/main.yaml's project_categories:), each category
% (after the first) and each project inside it starting on its own
% page — configurable via data/portfolio-pdf.yaml's
% layout.new_page_per_project. ----
\input{sections/projects.tex}

\newpage
\section*{Design Team Experience}
\input{sections/design-team.tex}

\newpage
\section*{Internships}
\input{sections/internships.tex}

\end{document}
